definitions.explanation: Clothing worn under outer garments, next to the skin.

examples.japanese: {下着|したぎ}を{買|か}いに{行|い}きます。
{新|あたら}しい{下着|したぎ}に{着替|きが}えた。
{下着|したぎ}は{毎日|まいにち}{洗|あら}います。
examples.english: I wash my underwear every day.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}には{下着|したぎ}を{何枚|なんまい}{持|も}っていきますか。
examples.english: How many pairs of underwear are you taking on the trip?

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{暖|あたた}かい{下着|したぎ}を{着|き}ると{寒|さむ}さを{防|ふせ}げます。
examples.english: In winter, wearing warm underwear can help protect against the cold.

notes:
{下着|したぎ} is a general term for underwear, covering all types of undergarments.

TYPES OF UNDERWEAR:
- パンツ: underpants, briefs
- ブラジャー: bra
- シャツ: undershirt
- 肌着|はだぎ}: underwear worn next to skin

RELATED TERMS:
- {上着|うわぎ}: jacket, outer garment
- {服|ふく}: clothes (general)
- {着替|きが}え: change of clothes

Note: {下着|したぎ} is a compound of {下|した} (under) + {着|ぎ} (wearing/clothes).
